recommendations.recommendation: Listen attentively and obey the abbot, who stands in for Christ.
recommendations.rationale: Obedience is the path back to God and reflects Christ's own obedience.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Disobedience and resistance to the abbot.

recommendations.recommendation: Practice humility in every aspect of life.
recommendations.rationale: Humility is the way to exalt God and to grow in holiness.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep silence and avoid idle talk.
recommendations.rationale: Silence fosters attention to God and guards against sin.

recommendations.recommendation: Hold all things in common and do not claim private property.
recommendations.rationale: Shared possession protects the community and frees the monk from attachment.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Private ownership and attachment to possessions.

recommendations.recommendation: Pray and chant the Divine Office at the set hours of the day.
recommendations.rationale: Prayer at set hours keeps the community turned toward God throughout the day.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Neglect of the set hours of prayer.

recommendations.recommendation: Balance manual labor and sacred reading at set times each day.
recommendations.rationale: Work and reading together keep the monk from idleness.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Welcome guests and receive them as if they were Christ.
recommendations.rationale: Christ is present in the stranger, so guests deserve honor.
Murmuring undermines the community and the monk's own peace.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Do not be quick to anger, and keep peace with others.
recommendations.rationale: Anger disrupts community life and the pursuit of God.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Remain in the same monastery for life, practicing stability.
recommendations.rationale: Stability keeps the monk rooted in the community and in God's service.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Wandering from one community to another.
